id: title:Gilbert09:classify exhausted 429 retries as self recovering

review.posthog_relevance: Adds recovery behavior for Auth0 warehouse ingestion by distinguishing recoverable rate-limit exhaustion (429 Client Error) from other errors, allowing Temporal activity-level retry instead of immediate pagination failure.
review.reason: The change adds a new method returning a set containing the string '429 Client Error' and a corresponding unit test. This establishes a bounded, substantive improvement in the reliability of the Auth0 warehouse ingestion workflow by explicitly handling a recoverable error state. The implementation and its validation are visible in the supplied hunks.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of implementation and test, but the actual production benefit and complete operational context are not independently verified; this score does not account for unverified outcomes or adoption.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new method get_retryable_errors returning a set containing the string '429 Client Error'.
observations.posthog_connection: Defines a set of HTTP status codes that, when encountered during Auth0 warehouse ingestion, should not trigger immediate pagination failure but allow Temporal activity-level retry, distinguishing recoverable rate-limit exhaustion from other errors.

observations.behavior: Adds a unit test asserting that the observed error message contains a key present in the returned retryable errors set.
observations.code_quote: assert any(key in observed_error for key in retryable_errors)
observations.posthog_connection: Validates that the implementation correctly identifies the 429 Client Error string as a retryable condition, supporting the recovery behavior described in P1.F1.H1.
